unsafe_justifications: The private x86/x86_64 quote_backslash_avx512 function is entered only after root is_supported confirms AVX-512F and AVX-512BW, including OS vector state with std or statically enabled features without std.

The unaligned 512-bit load reads exactly a borrowed 64-byte array. Partial input is first copied by tails::load_block; no vector load reads a short or empty slice, assumes alignment, or accesses padding outside the array.
Architecture imports and the target-feature function are cfg-gated. Only AVX-512F and AVX-512BW instructions are used. Unsupported configurations call tails::classify_scalar_raw.
test_vectors: Canonical ClassifyFn assignment and empty input under all four canonical incoming quote states, preserving opaque UTF-8 fields.
All 256 byte values repeated across all 64 lanes and 256 mixed blocks generated with an odd byte stride, checked against an independent byte oracle.
Quotes and backslashes individually at every lane, including bit 63, plus alternating 0x5555555555555555 and 0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa masks.
Literal punctuation and escaped-quote vector with exact raw masks, string-content mask, structural filtering, whitespace/control overlap, digits, and non-ASCII bits.
Every length from zero through 64 with all four carry states, mixed classes, zero bytes, and spaces; validates clipping and padded-zero exclusion.
Fixed-array and slice pipeline equivalence around lanes 15/16, 31/32, 47/48, and 62/63.
Backslash runs of every possible length before a quote, a full block of backslashes, and escape parity carried into a subsequent quote.
A deterministic 128-byte stream split at every boundary from zero through 64, including an escape run spanning bytes 63/64, compared with block and bytewise reference state.
A deliberately unaligned full array and every bounded subslice length with surrounding non-ASCII sentinels.
Oversized lengths 65, 127, 128, 255, 256, and 257, including simultaneous invalid carry, with exact error metadata and unchanged carry.
Noncanonical carry values 2, 255, 256, 2^63, and u64::MAX in either or both quote fields, for empty, partial, and full input.
Invalid JSON syntax, invalid escape spellings, raw controls, invalid UTF-8, trailing backslashes, and unclosed strings remain valid scanner inputs.
